title: NettingCell
description: A governed triparty netting cell — the smallest local clearing object that couples value, proof, authority, and disclosure. Cancels interior circulation across three legs and governs release/refund/export by policy rather than confidence alone.

party.description: Party URN / identifier for this leg.

role.description: Triparty leg role (A, B are counterparties; C is the clearing/verifier leg).

valueRef.description: The monetary/asset value this leg carries into the cell.

capabilityRef.description: The capability right this leg carries (from the CapabilityRegistry) — kept distinct from value.

proofRef.description: The proof/attestation this leg carries (Truth Engine) — evidence distinct from permission.

legs.description: The three triparty legs (A, B counterparties; C clearing/verifier).

truthClass.description: Truth class of the cell's current state (constitution): PROVEN⊐ATTESTED⊐INFERRED⊐REPUTED.

admissibility.description: Current admissibility ceiling on the lattice evidence⊇admit⊇release⊇export. Export is stricter than local validity.

bundleRefs.description: The typed bundles that moved this cell through its lifecycle.

policyKernelRef.description: The PolicyKernel that disposes release/refund/export (policy disposes; evidence proposes; proof preserves).

supplyChainRef.description: Optional hg: / node ref when this cell clears a supply-chain trade.
